roles.name: Peace Maker
roles.ability: Once in the final round, restore half the Grace meter when the Fallen are close to winning.

roles.name: Wise
roles.ability: Once per meeting, a correct False Prophet accusation reveals a movement or task clue.

roles.name: Discern
roles.ability: Once per meeting, challenge suspicious evidence; a correct challenge reveals a clue, while a wrong challenge risks elimination.

roles.name: Resist
roles.ability: Resist temptation twice and avoid voting for three rounds to unlock a special Chosen victory condition.

roles.name: Anointed
roles.ability: Bond with a player; repeated choices unlock stronger effects, but mistakes can endanger both bonded players.

roles.name: Liar
roles.ability: Up to three times per game, nominate three suspects; if the selected target is voted out, gain protection from Taskgiver interference.

roles.name: Lust
roles.ability: Once per meeting, use a proximity-based temptation or attack, subject to lobby-size and distance rules.

roles.name: False Prophet
roles.ability: Once per meeting, spread a false claim; belief creates delayed consequences, but failure exposes the Prophet.

roles.name: Tempter
roles.ability: Once per game, offer a player a dangerous choice between accepting corruption and resisting.

roles.name: Crafter
roles.ability: Choose a Bible-related word once per game; if spoken unnoticed during a meeting, trigger a delayed attack.

roles.name: Antichrist
roles.ability: If other Fallen are eliminated, attempt a special revival or recruitment under strict endgame rules.

roles.name: Taskgiver
roles.ability: Choose between two secret offers; completing one before next round grants a benefit that may help you, the target, or Fallen.

roles.name: Prosecutor
roles.ability: Mark a player; if they are voted out within three rounds, complete your personal objective.

roles.name: Busybody
roles.ability: Choose a player and complete your objective if they are voted out in the designated round.

roles.name: Instigator
roles.ability: Provoke two players; win if the required conflict and elimination sequence succeeds.

roles.name: Theological
roles.ability: Offer allegiance to Chosen or Fallen; each acceptance unlocks a different objective and power set; rejection by both defeats you.

roles.name: Shepherd
roles.ability: Protect one player from one attack each round; cannot protect the same player consecutively.

roles.name: Watchman
roles.ability: Receive an alert when a player enters or leaves a chosen room, without revealing their role.

roles.name: Scribe
roles.ability: Record a public claim and reveal a contradiction if the speaker later changes it.

roles.name: Healer
roles.ability: Restore some Grace after a healing challenge, up to twice per game.

roles.name: Lampbearer
roles.ability: Illuminate a darkened room and reveal traces of recent sabotage, not the saboteur.

roles.name: Intercessor
roles.ability: Once per game, cancel one vote against a player after completing a challenge.

roles.name: Pilgrim
roles.ability: Complete three location objectives to earn a temporary bonus vote.

roles.name: Builder
roles.ability: Repair a sabotaged castle location faster than other players.

roles.name: Witness
roles.ability: Privately confirm that a task or sabotage event occurred; identity requires separate evidence.

roles.name: Martyr
roles.ability: Sacrifice your next action once per game to protect another player from elimination.

roles.name: Shadow Walker
roles.ability: Move between connected rooms without triggering ordinary movement alerts; disabled during lockdown.

roles.name: Saboteur
roles.ability: Disable one castle location until repaired; cannot target the same location in consecutive rounds.

roles.name: Whisperer
roles.ability: Send one anonymous misleading clue that can be checked against server records.

roles.name: Hex Keeper
roles.ability: Curse a location so its next task takes longer; ends when completed or round expires.

roles.name: Puppeteer
roles.ability: Temporarily influence one vote with a modifier but cannot fully override the voter.

roles.name: Night Stalker
roles.ability: Mark a player and learn the next room they visit for one round.

roles.name: Counterfeiter
roles.ability: Create one false task-completion report that can be exposed by verification roles.

roles.name: Silencer
roles.ability: Mute one player during part of a meeting; they can still vote.

roles.name: Usurper
roles.ability: Once per game, block another player’s active ability; target is notified of the block.

roles.name: Harbinger
roles.ability: Trigger a countdown forcing players to choose between repairing a location and gathering evidence.

roles.name: Mediator
roles.ability: Require two nominated players to state evidence before voting; win if neither is eliminated in that meeting.

roles.name: Collector
roles.ability: Gather three hidden relics from different rooms and survive the next meeting.

roles.name: Fortune Teller
roles.ability: Receive one of two possible clues and win by correctly predicting two voting outcomes.

roles.name: Merchant
roles.ability: Offer temporary trades of task benefits; win after two accepted trades and survival.

roles.name: Pilferer
roles.ability: Take an unclaimed task reward; win by collecting two rewards without exposure.

roles.name: Arbitrator
roles.ability: Break a tied vote between tied candidates; win if the selected candidate is eliminated and you survive.

roles.name: Archivist
roles.ability: Unlock Bible-history clues through knowledge challenges; win by finding two clues and identifying a faction.

roles.name: Double Agent
roles.ability: Choose a faction to assist for one round; win by completing its objective without exposing your choice.

roles.name: Redeemer
roles.ability: Offer a player a chance to reverse one temporary negative effect; win if they survive the next meeting.

roles.name: Opportunist
roles.ability: Choose a public objective each round; win by completing three different objectives.

note: Role descriptions are design data. Each ability needs server-side implementation and multiplayer testing before it can be considered fully playable.
